about.title: About {store}
about.lead: {store} is an Iraqi online store selling phones, tablets and accessories. Prices are in dinars, payment is on delivery, and we deliver to every governorate.
about.codBody: You pay nothing up front. See the order in your hands first, then pay.
about.deliveryBody: We deliver to {count} governorates. The fee and the expected days are shown before you confirm the order.
about.warrantyBody: The warranty period is written on each product's own page, not left as a general claim.
about.step_browse: Browse the products, pick one, and choose the version — colour and storage.
about.step_order: Add it to the cart and complete the order: six fields, just your name, number and address.
about.step_confirm: We call to confirm, and give you a number to track the order with.
about.step_receive: The order arrives, you check it, and you pay on delivery.

contact.orderAnswer: The fastest route: track it with the order number and the phone number you ordered with. You see its status straight away, without waiting for a reply.
